title: Spinach and Artichoke Lasagne with Cottage Cheese and Béchamel
changes_from_base: Jammy fried artichoke hearts and wilted spinach bound with cottage cheese, parmesan and half the béchamel replace the meat ragù, and the dried sheets are softened in just-boiled water rather than boiled.
summary: A rich, creamy bake of jammy browned artichokes and wilted spinach bound in a cottage cheese filling under a bubbling golden crust.
equipment: large deep dish or roasting tin for soaking

ingredients.item: tinned artichoke hearts (one 400 g tin, drained weight), coarsely chopped and well drained
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Start
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C and boil a full kettle.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Heat the 60 ml oil over medium-high, add the 240 g artichokes and cook 10-15 min, stirring now and then, until they break down and brown at the edges.

steps.title: Wilt
steps.text: Add the 140 g spinach with ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper and stir 2-3 min until well wilted, then tip into the large bowl and keep the pan.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Melt the 55 g butter, whisk in the 30 g flour for 1-2 min, then slowly whisk in the 475 ml milk and 475 ml cream, simmer 10-20 min until as thick as gravy and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Stir half the sauce into the artichokes and leave 15 min, meanwhile laying the 12 sheets in a deep dish, covering with the just-boiled water and soaking about 15 min until bendy.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir the 225 g cottage cheese, 55 g parmesan, egg and seasoning into the artichoke mixture.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Coat the square dish thinly with sauce, lay in about 3 sheets with ends up the sides, spread on half the artichoke mix, turn the dish 90 degrees, add 3 more sheets and half the remaining sauce, then repeat ending with sauce and scatter over the 115 g mozzarella.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 15-20 min until bubbling at the corners and the cheese and sheet ends are golden and crisp.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave at least 30 min before slicing.

tips: Cook the artichokes until they turn jammy and catch at the edges for the best flavour.
Soak the sheets only until bendy, not soggy, so they hold their shape.
Give the finished lasagne a good half hour to firm up before cutting.
storage: Chill leftovers and keep for up to 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
